title: React & TypeScript Masterclass
description: Build production-ready React applications with TypeScript. Covers hooks, context, state management with Zustand, testing with Vitest, and deployment strategies.

title: UI/UX Design Fundamentals
description: Learn the principles of user interface and user experience design. From wireframing to high-fidelity prototypes using Figma. Includes accessibility and design systems.

title: Python for Data Science
description: Comprehensive introduction to data science with Python. Covers NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, scikit-learn, and real-world data analysis projects.

title: Digital Marketing Strategy
description: Master digital marketing channels including SEO, SEM, social media, email marketing, and analytics. Build a complete marketing plan from scratch.

title: Startup Business Essentials
description: Everything you need to launch and grow a startup. Covers business models, fundraising, lean methodology, financial planning, and scaling strategies.

title: Advanced Machine Learning
description: Deep dive into neural networks, NLP, computer vision, and reinforcement learning. Hands-on projects with TensorFlow and PyTorch.

title: Full-Stack Node.js Development
description: Build complete web applications with Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, and React. Covers authentication, REST APIs, WebSockets, and cloud deployment.

title: Motion Design with After Effects
description: Create stunning motion graphics and animations for web and video. Learn keyframing, expressions, character animation, and export for multiple platforms.
